system.description:
A ship is a tiny refuge of human order in the vast, inhuman sea. By tracing the burning yellow Sign of Journeys on a ship's prow, a Sidereal protects the ship and its passengers against supernatural forces. The Charm has four versions: one protects from gods and elementals, another from the Fair Folk and the Wyld, a third from the dead and forces of the Underworld and a fourth from demons and forces of Malfeas. The Sidereal gains access to all four versions upon learning this Charm. A vessel can carry only one form of protection at a time.

A banned entity cannot touch or board the ship unless the entity's Essence exceeds the Sidereal's. Rather than adding bonus dice to the defenders' pools, the Charm imposes an external penalty equal to the Sidereal's Essence on all attack rolls made by banned aggressors against the ship or its passengers. It costs 2wp per action for trespassers and aggressors to ignore this Charm's effects. Characters that have resisted three times ignore the effect for the rest of the scene.

Errata: Sidereals gain access to all versions of this Charm when they learn it, though a ship may still only benefit from one version at a time. It does not provide bonus dice to DVs, but instead imposes an equal external penalty on the attacks of aggressors. It costs 2wp per action for trespassers and aggressors to ignore this Charm's effects. Characters that have resisted three times ignore the effect for the rest of the scene.
